description: Download and web links for Fleek: Google Play for Android, the App Store for iPhone (in the countries where it's listed), and web.getfleek.app. With a country, the result says which of these are listed there.

country.description: The user's country: a name, an ISO code (US, GB, AE, IN) or a currency (USD, ₹). Brands and prices differ by country. Omitted means Fleek's global store, in USD.

platform.description: android, ios or web. Omit for all three.
